LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Helmet.label: lamellar helmet
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Helmet.description: A rounded iron helmet with a tall plume tube and a curtain of small plates hanging over the neck.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Lamellar.label: lamellar armour
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Lamellar.description: Hundreds of small iron plates laced into overlapping rows, with a lacquered breast mirror. Flexible and strong.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Hanfu.label: hanfu
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Hanfu.description: A long flowing robe with a crossed collar and wide sleeves, tied with a sash. It marks a person of learning.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_DragonRobe.label: dragon robe
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_DragonRobe.description: A robe of imperial yellow silk embroidered with a five-clawed dragon above the waves. Only the ruler and those he honours may wear it.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Futou.label: futou cap
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Futou.description: A black gauze cap with two long stiff wings at the back, worn by officials who passed the examinations. The wings stop them whispering to each other at court.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_ArmyCoat.label: new army coat
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_ArmyCoat.description: A short red coat with a dark border and the round placard of the new army on the chest and back.
